definitions.de: Löschen; ausmachen; ausschalten (Feuer, Licht, Motor); erlöschen
definitions.en: To extinguish; to turn off; to put out (fire, light, engine); to go out (of a flame)
definitions.es: Apagar; extinguir (fuego, luz, motor); apagarse (una llama)
definitions.fr: Éteindre; couper (feu, lumière, moteur); s'éteindre (d'une flamme)
definitions.hi: बुझाना; बंद करना (आग, बत्ती, इंजन); बुझ जाना (लौ का)
definitions.ja: 消す；消火する（火・電気・エンジンを）；（炎が）消える
definitions.km: ពន្លត់; បិទ (ភ្លើង ភ្លើងបំភ្លឺ ម៉ាស៊ីន); ផ្លុំ (ភ្លើង)
definitions.ko: 끄다; 불을 끄다; (불, 불빛, 엔진을) 끄다; (불꽃이) 꺼지다
definitions.ne: निभाउनु; बन्द गर्नु (आगो, बत्ती, इन्जिन); निभ्नु (ज्वाला)
definitions.pt: Apagar; extinguir (fogo, luz, motor); se apagar (uma chama)
definitions.th: ดับ; ปิด; ดับไฟ (ไฟ แสงสว่าง เครื่องยนต์); ดับลง (เปลวไฟ)
definitions.ur: بجھانا؛ بند کرنا (آگ، روشنی، انجن)؛ بجھ جانا (شعلہ)
definitions.vi: Tắt; dập tắt (lửa, đèn, máy); tắt đi (ngọn lửa)
definitions.zh: 熄灭；关掉（火、灯、引擎）；灭（火焰）
definitions.zh_Hant: 熄滅；關掉（火、燈、引擎）；滅（火焰）

definition_en: To extinguish; to turn off; to put out (fire, light, engine); to go out (of a flame)

lao_examples.lao_script: ດັບໄຟກ່ອນນອນດ້ວຍເນາະ
lao_examples.romanization: dap faj kɔ̀ːn nɔːn dûaj nɔ
lao_examples.translation_en: Turn off the light before going to sleep, okay?

lao_examples.lao_script: ດັບເຄື່ອງລົດກ່ອນລົງໄດ້ເລີຍ
lao_examples.romanization: dap khɯ̂aŋ lót kɔ̀ːn loŋ dâj ləːj
lao_examples.translation_en: You can turn off the engine before getting out.
